description: This file defines a React component named PasscodeLock used for managing passcode settings and auto-lock preferences in a web application. It includes state management, user interactions, encryption status updates, and references to external application services and UI components.

classes.name: PasscodeLock
classes.description: A React component that manages passcode and auto-lock settings, including adding, changing, removing passcodes, and configuring auto-lock timers.

methods.name: handleAddPassCode
methods.description: Activates the UI to add a new passcode.

methods.name: changePasscodePressed
methods.description: Triggers the process to change the existing passcode.

methods.name: reloadDesktopAutoLockInterval
methods.description: Fetches the current desktop auto-lock timer interval from the application service.

methods.name: refreshEncryptionStatus
methods.description: Updates state related to encryption and passcode presence, and updates the UI accordingly.

methods.name: selectDesktopAutoLockInterval
methods.description: Sets a new auto-lock interval after user selection.

methods.name: setMobilePasscodeTiming
methods.description: Configures the passcode autolock timing for mobile.

methods.name: removePasscodePressed
methods.description: Initiates removal of the current passcode, updating relevant preferences.

methods.name: handlePasscodeChange
methods.description: Handles input change for the passcode field.

methods.name: handleConfirmPasscodeChange
methods.description: Handles input change for the passcode confirmation field.

methods.name: submitPasscodeForm
methods.description: Validates and submits the form to set or change the passcode.
